- [Vaults](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/sandboxes/vaults.md): Group secrets under one name and pass them to sandboxes and browser sessions together.
- [1Password](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/sandboxes/1password.md): Read fields from your 1Password account into sandbox processes and browser login forms, without storing the values in Hyperbrowser.

- [Run manual CAPTCHA evaluation](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/manually-evaluate-captcha.md): Trigger a bounded CAPTCHA evaluation on an active browser session. Supported CAPTCHA targets are turnstile, cloudflare-challenge, aliexpress, recaptcha, and amazon.

- [Cancel a WebMCP invocation](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/cancel-webmcp-invocation.md): Request best-effort cancellation and return the current handle.

- [Get vault by ID](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/get-vault-by-id.md): Get a vault and its entries.
- [Update a vault](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/update-a-vault.md): Change a vault's description or entries.
- [Delete a vault](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/delete-a-vault.md): Delete a vault. The secrets it points at are kept.

- [Create a session with X402 payment](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/create-a-session-with-x402-payment.md): Purchase one browser session at 0.10 USDC per hour, paid upfront for timeoutMinutes (5–60, default 30). No Hyperbrowser account or API key is required. A valid unpaid request returns 402 with payment requirements. Retry with a signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE authorization. Payment is settled before connect…
- [Get an X402 session](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/get-an-x402-session.md): Get the purchased session's status and original expiry without another payment. Authenticate with managementToken, not the browser token. Connection credentials are not reissued.
- [Stop an X402 session](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/stop-an-x402-session.md): Stop the purchased browser without another payment. Authenticate with managementToken, not the browser token. An already closed or errored session also succeeds.
- [Fetch a web page with X402 payment](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/fetch-a-web-page-with-x402-payment.md): X402 payment endpoint. First request returns 402 with payment requirements. Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header containing cryptographic proof to get the actual data. See https://x402.gitbook.io/x402 for protocol details.
- [Search the web with X402 payment](https://hyperbrowser.ai/docs/api-reference/search-the-web-with-x402-payment.md): X402 payment endpoint. First request returns 402 with payment requirements. Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header containing cryptographic proof to get search results. See https://x402.gitbook.io/x402 for protocol details.
